quote: Okonkwo was a wealthy farmer and had two barns full of yams. He had three wives and a large compound.
The market-place was full of people... Umuofia was feared by all its neighbours. It was powerful in war and in magic.
Every clan had an Evil Forest into which was thrown all those who died of the really evil diseases... It was an evil forest, alive with sinister forces.
It was a little village called Mbanta, just beyond the borders of Mbaino... Okonkwo was well received by his mother's kinsmen.
They asked for a plot of land to build their church... The elders offered them the Evil Forest, believing they would die within four days.
The white man had also built a court where the District Commissioner judged cases in ignorance.
The royal python was the most revered animal in Mbanta and all the surrounding clans. It was addressed as 'Our Father'.
